fact: On 1 October 2025 ADPME and the Beninese bank BIIC launched the Fonds d'appui à l'entrepreneuriat numérique, financing seed start-ups up to FCFA 10 million and co-financing older ones up to FCFA 25 million.
title: Accord Adpme-Biic: Un fonds pour propulser l'entrepreneuriat numérique au Bénin
